title: Phát triển phần mềm mã nguồn mở và ứng dụng

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master the process of developing open source software, including licensing, community dynamics, and practical applications.
Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in open source software development, such as Python.
Understanding and practical use of open source database management systems like MySQL.
Ability to manage and organize group activities effectively, including planning and executing projects.
Effective communication in writing and presenting technical information related to open source software development.
Proficiency in using version control systems such as Git for managing software development projects.
Proficiency in using Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) like Eclipse and NetBeans for software development.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Understanding and adherence to ethical and social responsibilities in the field of information management systems.
